command:
source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
export PYTHONPATH=/work/ids_lane_private_v2/ids_lane:/work/ids_lane_private_v2/source"${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/work/ids_lane_private_v2/results/ids_audit_perf_v2/triton_cache
export ASCEND_CACHE_PATH=/work/ids_lane_private_v2/results/ids_audit_perf_v2/ascend_cache
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 ASCEND_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4 IDS_PHYSICAL_CHIP=4
export HCCL_DETERMINISTIC=strict LCCL_DETERMINISTIC=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export V41_DUMMY_WO_A_FIX=1 VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1
exec python3 /work/ids_lane_private_v2/ids_lane/bench_ids_model.py --output /work/ids_lane_private_v2/results/ids_audit_perf_v2 --pairs 12 --profile
